label: Rules
short: A written rule that names AI tools and says what must not go in, on a document ladder.
strong: The rule exists, names the tools, and staff start from it. Check it names the tools staff use this year.

middle.2: Rung 2: add one paragraph that names the AI tools and the information that staff must not put into them.
middle.3: Rung 3, out of date: refresh it.
middle.4: Rung 4, not linked: link it from the handbook.

edge: No rule at all. A one-page rule that names the tools and lists what must not go in is a two-hour task, with the guide to verification and safety at work as the template.
unmet: If nobody can find a rule, there is no rule.
